name: r032.prepared_camp_mission_food_storage_v001_mcw
description: R-032 focused established-camp route: a disposable derived fixture supplies existing CAMP_FOOD/CAMP_STORAGE footing and cooked food as zero-credit setup.  The live run must use only current native semantic owners to inspect that footing, distribute food, send an assigned worker on an already-native advertised three-hour companion mission, advance only through native World actions until its matching return is offered, and observe the native return result.

steps.label: operate_r032_food_storage_and_mission
steps.objective: Use only advertised native semantic actions to confirm the prepared Food/Storage footing and supplied-food precondition as setup, then distribute food, select one currently available three-hour companion mission, choose a current available worker, advance native time until the matching recovery entry is offered, and return that worker.
proof_targets: same-run current native Food and Storage zone observations and installed food as setup-only footing
accepted food-distribution receipt and a post-action food-supply observation
accepted native mission-board, worker-choice, mission-start, elapsed-time, recovery, and return receipts for the same companion mission
invariants: fixture installation, zones, and cooked food are zero-credit setup only
the Food and Storage observations establish prerequisites, not Food/Storage worker behavior
board opening or accepted selection alone does not prove a mission
mission credit requires one actual worker departure on an advertised companion mission, a native elapsed-time route, and that same mission's successful native recovery/return observation
do not use physical controls, OCR, coordinates, source inference, direct state mutation, direct save edits, or synthetic receipt injection
Locker and Patrol remain independent uncredited claims
stop the affected claim at missing native receipt, unavailable prerequisite, source-binding drift, stale owner, or cleanup failure while retaining independent evidence
